english: They found a solution to the problem.

english: The business made a large profit.
The cost of the business increased.

english: The customer paid for the product.

english: The company has a bank account.

igbo: Ha bufere ngwaahịa ahụ n'ụlọ ahịa.

igbo: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ natara iwu ahụ.

igbo: Ha chọrọ ime ka ọrụ ha ka mma.
english: They want to improve their service.

english: Business provides people with job opportunities.

igbo: Ịrụsi ọrụ ike na-enyere azụmahịa aka.

english: Business is important for community development.
